rules: A source rejection is lane-invariant and is not an early-failure gate sequence. It claims no pass for any unexecuted gate.

The candidate review, blocker, exact candidate pin and pin digest, source archive digest, relative source file and its SHA-256, inclusive line range, and exact raw line-range SHA-256 are frozen before collection.

Source file SHA-256 covers the exact archive-member bytes. The inclusive line-range preimage starts immediately after the lineStart-minus-one LF byte and ends immediately after lineEnd's LF byte, or at EOF when that line has no LF; byte 0x0A is the only line delimiter and no decoding, newline conversion, or Unicode normalization is allowed.

Only a direct contradiction of an eligible mandatory requirement in the exact pinned bytes may reject a candidate. Missing adapter, build, native, or measurement evidence is incomplete evidence, not a source rejection.
Two independent reviewers who did not author candidate glue approve the exact blocker digest before collection. A disputed or unapproved blocker makes the comparison incomplete.
A patched alternative is a new exact candidate whose patch, ABI, dependency, owner-day, and bootstrap identities are frozen before every candidate and control restarts all three lanes.

standardsCorrections.requirement: Kitty wire formats are RGB, RGBA, and PNG. Grayscale content is supported when carried in a protocol-defined wire format; gray and gray-alpha are not separate Kitty wire format numbers.
standardsCorrections.effectOnSelection: No candidate is credited or rejected for a nonexistent gray wire-format number. Zlib, cropping, deletion, generations, placements, and all three z layers remain mandatory.

accountingRules: Count original encoded untrusted bytes incrementally before decode, normalization, sanitization, base64 decode, or copy.
Use checked arithmetic for every length, dimension, stride, pixel, and aggregate calculation.
Classify a named protocol before growth; its named limit replaces the generic body limit and nested limits remain conjunctive.
On overflow, enter a bounded discard-until-final or discard-until-terminator state without materializing the remaining body.
Reserve every physically distinct encoded, decoded, conversion, stored, snapshot, and upload allocation before allocation or expensive work.
Reservation failure is atomic and keeps the terminal usable.
A post-allocation eviction or line-count-only limit is not a pre-allocation byte cap.

gates.requirement: Windows 11 build 22000 compatibility; native x64 and ARM64 artifacts; x64 ASan-Debug-compatible consumer boundary; no unsupported operating-system or runtime prerequisite.
Legally distributable licenses and notices plus a complete source, tool, dependency, and runtime lock with verified digests.

After explicit bootstrap, two independent clean normal MSBuild-orchestrated builds are offline, use only frozen tools and inputs, and produce byte-identical raw artifacts for both architectures. A normalized or structural PE identity is diagnostic only and cannot substitute for exact raw identity.

An isolatable C or C++ ABI, or a fully source-vendored boundary, with exact compiler and runtime rules. Dynamic ABI identity is fail-closed and covers build, public headers, layouts, enums, calling convention, capabilities, and architecture.
Exactly one authoritative parser and state machine handles every PTY VT, OSC, APC, and Kitty byte. An authenticated shell side channel is allowed but is not a VT parser.

Correct resize and reflow, primary and alternate screens, byte-bounded scrollback, selection, hyperlinks, title, palette, keyboard, mouse, focus, bracketed paste, synchronized output, Unicode grapheme and wide-cell state, and renderer-owned immutable cell extraction.

Engine-owned static Kitty direct and chunked RGB, RGBA, and PNG state; zlib; placements; cropping; deletion; image and placement generations; and below-background, below-text, and above-text layers. All image limits and reservations occur before unbounded growth, decompression, decode, or conversion.

A documented serialized snapshot and update sequence leaks no borrowed pointer across mutation, has one producer per session, retries after failed publication, and reaches a deterministic callback-free unload quiet point.

The exact frozen encoded, decoded, dimension, pixel, scrollback, terminal CPU, Kitty CPU/GPU, session/process, conversion, and pending-effect limits are enforceable before allocation or expensive work with checked arithmetic and atomic failure.
Deterministic malformed and split UTF-8, VT, and image fixtures plus a fuzz seam demonstrate that untrusted PTY data cannot terminate the application.
The terminal child HWND and Direct2D/DirectWrite renderer remain builtin/terminal plugin-owned and consume a consumer-owned immutable cell, image, placement, and effect snapshot.

The frozen session, profile, pane-follow, path-insertion, folder-edit, command-history, shell-selection, shutdown, settings, and dependency-lifecycle contracts remain implementable without changing shell policy or trusting terminal output.
